# GitHub Light

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-github-light)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-github-light)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-github-light)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-github-light)

GitHub Light is a **light** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast. It belongs to the GitHub family.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-github-light codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `githubLight` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { githubLight } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-github-light';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, githubLight],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `githubLight` | `Extension` |
| `githubLightMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#ffffff` |
| Active line | `#f6fbff` |
| Selection | `#bbdfff` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.53:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#c10722` | bold | 6.32:1 | 6.07:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#c10722` | bold | 6.32:1 | 6.07:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#24292e` | - | 14.67:1 | 14.08:1 | 10.56:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#58616b` | - | 6.29:1 | 6.04:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#005cc5` | - | 6.29:1 | 6.04:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#005cc5` | - | 6.29:1 | 6.04:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#0e6f2a` | - | 6.31:1 | 6.06:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#6f42c1` | - | 6.51:1 | 6.25:1 | 4.69:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#c10722` | - | 6.32:1 | 6.07:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#6f42c1` | italic | 6.51:1 | 6.25:1 | 4.69:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#005cc5` | italic | 6.29:1 | 6.04:1 | 4.53:1 |
| String | `string` | `#032f62` | - | 13.23:1 | 12.71:1 | 9.52:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#032f62` | - | 13.23:1 | 12.71:1 | 9.52:1 |
| Number | `number` | `#953800` | - | 7.39:1 | 7.09:1 | 5.31:1 |
| Boolean | `bool` | `#953800` | - | 7.39:1 | 7.09:1 | 5.31:1 |
| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#005cc5` | - | 6.29:1 | 6.04:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Comment | `comment` | `#58616b` | italic | 6.29:1 | 6.04:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Meta | `meta` | `#58616b` | - | 6.29:1 | 6.04:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Tag | `tagName` | `#116329` | - | 7.39:1 | 7.10:1 | 5.32:1 |
| Attribute | `attributeName` | `#6f42c1` | - | 6.51:1 | 6.25:1 | 4.69:1 |
| Heading | `heading` | `#005cc5` | bold | 6.29:1 | 6.04:1 | 4.53:1 |
| Emphasis | `emphasis` | `#032f62` | italic | 13.23:1 | 12.71:1 | 9.52:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#24292e` | background, active line, selection | 10.56:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#6a737d` | gutter | 4.52:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#24292e` | background, active line | 14.08:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#035cc3` | background | 6.32:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #0366d6b0` | background, active line | 3.02:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#79b8ff, 1px solid #005cc5` | background (fill or outline) | 6.29:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#BBDFFF` | active line | 1.33:1 | Pass |
